raw: {"analysis":"DLP correctly identifies the dual approval requirement for production deployment and explicitly assigns it to Security and Platform leads, while GNB incorrectly has Jane Smith (Data Security squad lead) conducting the security review, which violates the separation of duties implied by the repository facts. DLP also provides a more precise rollback strategy that acknowledges the irreversibility constraint and requires a pre-ingestion cluster snapshot, whereas GNB's post-ingestion rollback description is muddled and potentially misleading about data accessibility after a fault. Both plans address the flaky Friday audit logger, but DLP's approach of triaging via a flake ledger before retrying is more operationally sound than GNB's blanket exclusion of the module on Fridays.","verdict":"DLP"}
